verdict.rationale: Evidence of third-party UI component libraries is thin. One community member reports porting react-bootstrap to SolidJS with little effort. First-party docs say Solid is web-component friendly and works easily with native JS libraries, so web component and vanilla UI libraries are usable. Another community member says ecosystem gaps are real, citing Framer Motion support lagging behind React's, which tempers any claim of a 'rich' ecosystem. Missing for 10: any documented catalog or examples of established third-party Solid component libraries, first-party docs on the component-library ecosystem, independent evidence of ecosystem breadth or maturity.
